global: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth with tender chashu pork slices. Topped with sesame seeds, chopped green onions, and dark pickled ginger, it sits in a patterned bowl against a warm pink background under soft, even lighting.

regions.background: The surface is a smooth, solid pinkish-red with subtle gradient shading and faint texture variations.
regions.bowl: The bowl is white ceramic with a colorful geometric pattern and a raised, decorated rim.
regions.soup: The broth with noodles shows golden-yellow, translucent noodles submerged in rich, oily broth with visible bubbles and floating toppings.
regions.meat: Chashu pork: tender, thinly sliced, with glossy surface and visible marbling, resting atop green onions and sesame seeds.
